definitions.explanation: regularly setting aside money or resources, typically for a specific purpose

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{積立|つみたて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I make regular savings every month.

examples.japanese: {積立|つみたて}⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}めた→貯める：27801_tameru⟧。
examples.english: I saved up travel funds through installment savings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{積立|つみたて}⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started investing a fixed amount every month for my future.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
The noun of ⟦{積|つ}み{立|た}てる→積み立てる：21136_tsumitateru⟧ (to save up in installments): ⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ (to pile up) + ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to set up).

USAGE:
- Setting aside a fixed sum regularly, often by automatic monthly deduction, for retirement, education or travel.
- {積立|つみたて}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to save in installments

COMPOUNDS:
- {積立|つみたて}⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧ (installment savings)
- {積立|つみたて}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (accumulation-type insurance)
- {積立|つみたて}⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧ (regular investment)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- つみたてNISA, a tax-free account for long-term regular investing, was introduced in 2018; since 2024 it continues as the つみたて{投資枠|とうしわく} (installment investment allowance) of the new NISA

- ⟦{貯蓄|ちょちく}→貯蓄：18972_chochiku⟧ (savings - general term)
